senses.definition_en: leg-pull, fib, joke

examples.english: I think it's disrespectful and foolish. It doesn't make sense, like a lot of things in this pandemic. It's a fraudulent joke.
examples.ref: 2022 March 28, Diana Serrano, quoting Poncho K., “Poncho K: "Lo que ha hecho Castilla y León con las salas de conciertos es una estafa y una tomadura de pelo"”, in El Español:
examples.text: Me parece una falta de respeto y un despropósito. No tiene sentido, como muchas de las cosas de esta pandemia. Es una estafa y una tomadora de pelo^([sic]).
examples.translation: I think it's disrespectful and foolish. It doesn't make sense, like a lot of things in this pandemic. It's a fraudulent joke.

glosses: leg-pull, fib, joke
